data.summary_en: GEPA-Curator improves self-improving agents’ prompt optimization by filtering noisy-learning-signal tasks and using prior-success retrieval to supply successful trajectories; on GoBrowse, ALFWorld, AppWorld, and τ-bench with Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 5, average performance meets/exceeds baselines, up to 20.7% over GEPA and 21.2% over ACE.
